verdict.rationale: Workable publishes a documented public REST API (v3, Bearer tokens, scoped permissions). It covers reading and writing jobs, candidates, ratings, offers, members, departments, stages, requisitions and events, plus registrable webhook subscriptions. The ReadMe reference has a live Try It runner and a reachable llms.txt index, so the core story is delivered directly and completely. missing for 10: a downloadable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (spec download disabled, all openapi paths 404), a sandbox/test tenant or test keys, an API changelog/deprecation policy, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: We provide you with an API that gives you full control over your data.
Returns a collection of your account jobs. Required scope: `r_jobs`. Accessible with all token types.
Creates a rating for a candidate. Required scope: `w_candidates`. Accessible with all token types.
Invites a member. Required scope: w_members. Accessible with all token types.
you can use the API to create all these candidates in Workable.
